Body.Content:
Update rollup 38

This update provides fixes and download links to the latest versions of these Site Recovery components:

  • Site Recovery unified setup/mobility agent (9.26.5269.1) for Windows/CentOS/Ubuntu machines—Used for replication from VMware and physical servers to Azure
  • Site Recovery configuration server (5.1.4500.0)
  • Site Recovery provider (5.1.4500.0)—Used for Hyper-V replication to Azure
  • Azure Recovery Services Agent (2.0.9165.0)—Used for replication of Hyper-V to Azure.

For more information, read KB 4513507.
